Description.SourceString: Monkfish skewers are the friend of any travelling Moon Garou. Compact and easy to carry, a couple of dozen can be taken on any scouting or hunting party. They also double-up as weapons, should a garou find themselves ambushed during a hearty meal. It's not uncommon to see a half-dead kalphite staggering about in the desert with rows of monkfish skewers puncturing their carapace. They look a little like a buffet dish.
